answer_1.quote: HIAGENT leverage subgoals as memory chunks, with a summarized observation as the observation for each memory chunk... This function encapsulates the synthesis of historical observations and actions, contextualized by the current subgoal, to produce a concise representation of the agent's state.
answer_1.outputs: Generated actions, subgoals, and summarized observations

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We use multiple metrics to evaluate both the effectiveness and efficiency of LLM-based agents in solving long-horizon tasks: (i) Progress Rate... (ii) Success Rate... (iii) Average Steps... (iv) Context Efficiency... (v) Run Time...
